title: It Works!
text: It Works!. I'm in my early fifties. I'm not having hot flashes yet, but I do find that I get too warm at night. I was excited to give this pillow case a try. I used to be one of those people who would frequently flip my pillow over during the night so I could have the cooler side. But over the last few years, I started using memory foam pillows that have a definitive right side, so I have gotten out of the habit of flipping my pillows in order to get the benefits of the memory foam. One side of this case is significantly cooler than the other. It's kind of fascinating to me how that works. The other side is softer and warmer. I have found that the cool side isn't continuous and it does reduce the amount of coolness rather quickly. I would estimate it to last for just a few minutes, but if you move your head to another spot, it's cool again.  I do like it when it's cool, but for the majority of the night, it's not.
